title: kate-ui: show the search in files pane
summary: cmd-shift-f opens a pane with a pattern field and the regex, case, and whole word toggles. Enter runs search_files over the project files, or over the open document paths without a project, and lists the groups with their hit labels. A click opens the file with the caret at the hit. Escape closes the pane.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. session.rs imports GPUI, the crate builds only on macOS, and the owner looks at the window after the change.

definitions.definition:
// gpui::actions!(kate_ui, [...]) declares these unit structs.
pub struct SearchInFiles;

/// The project files joined onto the base directory, or the open document paths when no project is loaded.
fn search_targets(project: Option<(&std::path::Path, &[std::path::PathBuf])>, open: &[std::path::PathBuf]) -> Vec<std::path::PathBuf>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: The search runs on a background thread with a limit of 2000 hits and posts the result to the window. The pane sits at the bottom and shows each group with the file name, then its hit labels indented. A hit click calls open_at with the hit line and column. A skipped file count shows at the end. Bind cmd-shift-f and add Search in Files to the Go menu. The test search_targets_prefers_the_project asserts Some((/p, [a.rs])) with open [/o/b.rs] gives [/p/a.rs] and None gives [/o/b.rs]. The owner searches a word across a project. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: session::tests::search_targets_prefers_the_project
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because search_targets does not exist. After the change the project files win and the open paths are the fallback.
